Toyota.note: Japanese brand with large European production (Yaris/Yaris Cross in Valenciennes-Onnaing FR, Corolla in Burnaston GB, Aygo X in Kolín CZ, C-HR in Sakarya TR); RAV4, bZ4X, Land Cruiser etc. come from Japan, the Urban Cruiser from Suzuki India and the Proace vans from Stellantis plants (ES/FR/IT/PL). Hilux source not verified.

Lexus.hq_entity: Lexus (luxury division of Toyota Motor Corporation)

Subaru.note: Cars are built in Ōta/Yajima (Gunma); Solterra and Uncharted are Toyota-built rebadges (Japan).

Suzuki.note: Vitara and S-Cross are built by Magyar Suzuki in Esztergom (HU), the Swift in Japan, the e Vitara by Suzuki Motor Gujarat (IN); the Across is a Toyota RAV4 rebadge from Japan – several countries, so no second flag.

Mazda.note: Mazda 6e and CX-6e are shipped from Changan Mazda in China and the Mazda2 Hybrid is a Toyota Yaris built in Valenciennes (FR); the rest is Japanese-built.

Honda.note: European ZR-V (GAC Honda, Guangzhou) and CR-V e:HEV/e:PHEV (Dongfeng Honda, Wuhan) come from China; Civic, Jazz, Prelude and Super-N are Japanese-built, so no second flag.

Hyundai.note: i30, Tucson and Kona are built in Nošovice (CZ), i20/Bayon/Ioniq 3 in İzmit (TR); Inster, Ioniq 5/6/9, Santa Fe, Nexo and Staria come from Korea.

Kia.note: Sportage, XCeed, EV2 and EV4 hatchback are built in Žilina (SK), the K4 in Mexico; the rest come from Korea.

Genesis.hq_entity: Genesis (luxury brand of Hyundai Motor Company)
Genesis.note: Wikipedia gives no head-office row for the brand; it is a Hyundai Motor Company division (Seoul) and European models are built in Ulsan.
